entities.summary: Gaëlle Nayo-Ketchanke is a French weightlifter. She holds six French records. She is a 4 time silver medalist at the European Championships at the women's 75 kg and 81 kg events. In April 2019 she suffered a serious injury at the European Championships, breaking her arm in two places while attempting to snatch 107 kg. After just 5 months, she returned to competition at the World Championships in Pattaya.
